column1: # Layer 1 — instrument validity, one record per row, fixed BEFORE the live reading. Schema for INSTRUMENT.md.
# Keyed per Sol finding 1 to instrument_id/axis/regime/readout; a broken axis fails only its own reading.
# Resolution numbers are fixed here, not at reading time:
#   input_floor_lo (largest input shown NOT to cross), input_floor_hi (smallest shown to cross; a measured point has lo=hi),
#   parser_ok, raw_integrity (raw matches the artifact_set digest),
#   control_streams (the named list fixed in INSTRUMENT.md: seqB,seqC,seeds,bin-md5,corpus-md5,cm=),
#   sensitivity_positive (the forced-signal row at the declared magnitude returns `detected` under the reading law),
#   resolution_measured (the numbers above are measured, not asserted),
#   provenance_ok (every manifest in artifact_set carries force_site, a source hash, a HEAD whose tree contains it, and a build record incl bin hash).
# instrument_valid = conjunction of the six booleans, carried beside them, never alone.
